summary: FASE 5 (Agenda/citas) frontend-only testing via Playwright on the public preview URL. Verified sidebar navigation to /agenda, day view with 3 seeded appointments (time-sorted, customer, service, DOP$ price, status badge), week view (7 columns, today highlighted, per-day counts), prev/next/Hoy navigation in both views, appointment creation for today linked to posStore customers (6 options incl. Cliente Mostrador) and catalog services (12 service options), day-view update, dashboard 'Citas Hoy' KPI (kpi-card-citas) increment 3->4 and dashboard-appointments-list showing the new appointment, localStorage persistence ('diedo-agenda' survives reload), edit (time + status update reflected), delete (removed from agenda AND dashboard, KPI back to 3), form validation (empty time -> 'Selecciona una hora.'), week day-column click prefilling that date. No console errors; no 'Maximum update depth exceeded' / getSnapshot loop on /agenda or /dashboard. All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: Edit/Delete actions are hidden behind `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` — on touch devices (mobile/tablet) they are invisible though tappable, so users cannot discover edit/delete. Suggest always-visible (or focus-visible + sm:hover) actions.
Tailwind `capitalize` capitalizes every word: label renders 'Dom, 23 De Ago 2026' instead of 'Dom, 23 de ago 2026' (incorrect Spanish typography). Use `first-letter:uppercase` or drop capitalize.
Delete is immediate with only a toast — no confirmation dialog and no undo, unlike destructive actions elsewhere. Risk of accidental data loss.

integration_issues.flow: Edit appointment -> remove service / zero values
integration_issues.issue: agendaStore.updateAppointment uses `Number(data.price) || a.price` and `Number(data.duration) || a.duration`. If a user edits an appointment to 'Sin servicio' (price 0) or clears duration, serviceName becomes '' but the OLD price/duration is retained -> stale price shown with no service. Should use explicit null/NaN checks.

integration_issues.flow: Seed data vs persistence across days
integration_issues.issue: SEED dates are computed with todayKey() only at first store creation and then persisted. Opening the app on a later day leaves seeds on the old dates, so day view / 'Citas Hoy' KPI show 0 for an existing user. Consider a version/migrate step that re-anchors mock seeds to the current day.

issues: Uses native browser date/time inputs (type=date, type=time) instead of the app's styled picker — inconsistent look vs the rest of the UI and locale-dependent (shows MM/DD/YYYY, 09:00 AM in an es-UX app).
No duration validation (accepts empty/negative/0; falls back to 30 silently).
Day-view appointment cards have large unused whitespace due to fixed grid row height (see screenshot) — minor spacing polish.

action_items: Make agenda edit/delete actions visible on touch devices (remove hover-only opacity).
Fix updateAppointment falsy-fallback so price/duration can legitimately be 0 / service removal clears price.
Re-anchor mock seed appointment dates on load (persist version/migrate) so agenda/KPI are not empty on subsequent days.
Optional polish: correct 'De Ago' capitalization, add delete confirmation, localized date/time pickers.
critical_code_review_comments: agendaStore.updateAppointment: `Number(data.price) || a.price` silently discards valid 0 values — use `data.price === undefined ? a.price : Number(data.price) || 0`.
Seed data is persisted verbatim; add persist `version` + `migrate` to refresh mock dates.
getByDate/getToday store getters are unused by components (components use useMemo over raw array) — either use them or remove to avoid dead code / re-render traps.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Fase 5 acceptance flows passed (13/13 checks)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one test appointment for today (17:45, María Fernández, 50% Restante de Ciclo) in browser localStorage only; also edited apt-seed-1 time/status in a throwaway browser context (no shared state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 5 agenda flows all pass: nav-agenda, agenda-day-view, agenda-week-view, agenda-prev/next/today, agenda-new-btn + appointment-form-modal (customer/service/status/date/time), dashboard kpi-card-citas + dashboard-appointments-list, edit/delete, localStorage 'diedo-agenda'. No console errors or render loops. Remaining open items are UX/robustness (hover-only action buttons, falsy price/duration fallback in updateAppointment, seed dates not re-anchored after day change).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional blocker found. Falsy-fallback bug root cause: JS `||` treats 0 as falsy in updateAppointment, so zero price/duration edits are ignored.
